text: A Song of Ascents. Of David. I rejoiced when they said to me, “Let us go to the House of ADONAI.”
Our feet are standing in your gates, Jerusalem —
Jerusalem, built as a city joined together.
There the tribes go up, the tribes of ADONAI — as a testimony to Israel — to praise the Name of ADONAI.
For there thrones for judgment are set up, the thrones of the house of David.
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem — “May those who love you be at peace!
May there be shalom within your walls — quietness within your palaces.”
For the sake of my brothers and friends, I now say: “Shalom be within you.”
For the sake of the House of ADONAI our God, I will seek your good.
